description: This file defines an enumeration for handling unavailable features and a static class 'Capabilities' that manages various build and environment capabilities of the PDFsharp library, including build configuration, OS detection, feature availability, and actions for unsupported features. It includes nested classes for build info, OS info, feature availability, actions, and compatibility settings.

classes.name: FeatureNotAvailableBehavior
classes.description: Enumerates actions to take when a requested feature is not available.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Provides static properties and nested classes to query PDFsharp build capabilities, environment, and feature support.

methods.name: ResetAll
methods.description: Resets capability settings to the initial state immediately after loading the library, mainly for unit testing purposes.
